notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (EY). Thousand Baht. SCI three months p.5, six months p.7. Note 6 six months, total columns: revenue p.50, expenses and reinsurance p.51 (incurred claims include PAA). The insurance-contract notes are split by product group: 7 non-participating, 8 participating (indirect), 9 universal life, 10 participating (direct) / unit-linked. CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 7.2 + 8.2 + 9.2 + 10.2 (p.58, 63, 68, 72; six months); new business = 7.3 + 8.3 + 10.3 (p.60, 65, 74; universal life wrote none). Each summed item records the group 7 page. Unlike the 1Q2025 edition, this edition prints the roll-forward movements with the balance sign (release negative, new business positive), so no sign turn is needed. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM columns). Accretion = the profit-or-loss part of the insurance-finance row (CSM column; '-' for group 10). Group 10 shows no onerous new business for the six months although 1Q2025 printed 163 for it (recorded as printed). Other revenue = รายการอื่น. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2568 (p.5).
